name: rentemester-document-company-contexts-v19
sql:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS document_company_contexts (
  document_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES documents(id),
  company_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES companies(id),
  document_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(document_sha256)=64 AND document_sha256 NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-fA-F]*'),
  payload_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(payload_sha256)=64 AND payload_sha256 NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-fA-F]*'),
  company_snapshot_json TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(company_snapshot_json) BETWEEN 2 AND 65536 AND json_valid(company_snapshot_json)),
  company_snapshot_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(company_snapshot_sha256)=64 AND company_snapshot_sha256 NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-fA-F]*'),
  source_reference TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(trim(source_reference)) BETWEEN 1 AND 2000),
  business_use_reason TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(trim(business_use_reason)) BETWEEN 1 AND 2000),
  context_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(context_sha256)=64 AND context_sha256 NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-fA-F]*'),
  actor TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(trim(actor)) BETWEEN 1 AND 256),
  program TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(trim(program)) BETWEEN 1 AND 256),
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
);
CREATE TRIGGER document_company_contexts_no_update BEFORE UPDATE ON document_company_contexts BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'document company contexts are append-only'); END;
CREATE TRIGGER document_company_contexts_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON document_company_contexts BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'document company contexts are append-only'); END;
